meta.description: MixPad 4 smart voice switch: 4 lighting circuits, an IR remote for 9600+ appliance brands, voice control, a music library and a multi-protocol smart gateway in one panel.
sec2.title:
Fully upgraded
The specs of a premium
voice smart screen
sec2.desc: A smart gateway, AC panel, background music panel and AI voice speaker in one, now with 4-circuit light control, infrared appliance control and up to 400W per circuit. MixPad 4 is the smart hub for your whole home.
sec2.infrared:
New IR control for
9600+ appliance brands
sec2.notes:
[1] “2×” compares MixPad Mini, which controls up to 2 light circuits, with MixPad 4, which controls up to 4.
[2] “2×” compares the maximum load per circuit of MixPad Mini and MixPad 4. Actual results may vary with the materials and build of each brand's lights.
sec3.title:
Powerful 4-circuit light control
One screen for a large room
sec3.desc:
Controls up to four lighting circuits and suits any room, with no extra smart switches to buy.
Simple and worry-free.
sec4.title: Hidden IR control makes old appliances smart
sec4.desc: Built-in infrared control works with IR appliances from 9600+ brands at up to 20 m¹, turning the ones you already own into smart appliances.
sec4.desc2: [1] Based on ORVIBO lab tests. Walls of different materials reflect different amounts of energy; the actual range depends on the installation.
sec5.title: Instant voice control for your lights
sec5.desc:
Patented One Step voice technology and improved microphone noise reduction make it more sensitive, with a range of up to 7 m.
One sentence turns on the lights: that's real smart.
sec5.voice.heater: Turn on the water heater at 10.
sec5.voice.movieNap: Start movie mode, then nap mode.
sec5.voice.fan: Turn off the living room fan.
sec5.voice.water: Remind me to drink water at 11.
sec6.title: Full-screen display, every switch at a glance
sec6.desc:
An HD IPS screen with an ultra-wide 180° viewing angle, a clean, simple interface and a full set of touch switches
make it easy to control every smart device in your home.
sec7.title:
Your phone is your
universal remote
sec7.desc: Control your whole smart home from the app, anytime, anywhere, and never worry about appliances left on again.
sec8.title: A music library for every mood and moment
sec8.desc:
MixPad 4 comes with a library of 10 million licensed songs you can play with a single sentence,
and lets you set background music for your own scenes to make every moment at home special.
sec8.tips: Music library: requires a membership of the music service
sec9.title: Panel-to-panel intercom: no more shouting
sec9.desc: Talk to the MixPad in any other room as easily as with a walkie-talkie. Perfect for big homes.
sec9.title2: Voice intercom: answer the door from your bedroom
sec9.desc2: When someone comes to the door, talk to them through MixPad 4.
sec10.bubble_door: Please leave it at the door.
sec11.title: High load capacity for any powerful main light
sec11.desc:
A total load of up to 1200W¹ and up to 400W per circuit handle powerful main lights with ease,
and the industry-first Relay Pro Tech™ extends its life to up to 15 years².
sec11.desc2:
[1] Based on ORVIBO lab data. The total load is calculated as 2 circuits at max. 200W + 2 circuits at max. 400W, for a total of max. 1200W.
[2] Based on ORVIBO lab tests with 400W LED lights: relay life over 60,000 cycles and button life over 120,000 presses, which at 10 switches a day comes to 16.4 years. Actual results may vary with the materials and build of each brand's lights.
sec12.title: Multi-protocol hub for seamless connections
sec12.desc: Supports Zigbee, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and more for faster, more stable connections with almost no delay between all your devices.
sec12.desc2: MixPad 4 will support the safer, more open Matter ecosystem, opening up countless smart home experiences.
sec12.desc3: *The brands above are taken from the official CSA (Connectivity Standards Alliance) website.
sec13.title:
Swap in place
No wall damage
sec13.desc: The back box fits a standard 86-type wall box, so there's no need to rework the wall.
